subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should OpenClaw restore the shipped Discord elevated fallback from `channels.discord.allowFrom`, or confirm explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` as the current security contract?
rationale: The latest release documented the fallback, but current main no longer promises it and the behavior controls elevated host-exec authorization.

options.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
options.body: Implement Discord fallback through the existing channel plugin adapter, preserve explicit-empty denial, and update runtime, diagnostics, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Treat current docs as the intended security contract, close this issue with clear rationale, and ensure diagnostics point users to explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord`.

recommendation.title: Restore plugin-owned fallback
recommendation.body: Implement Discord fallback through the existing channel plugin adapter, preserve explicit-empty denial, and update runtime, diagnostics, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the current docs correction and the elevated/channel seam history that define the fallback boundary.
